# Categorical variable transformation
```{python include=FALSE}
import pandas as pd
import biogeme
import biogeme.version as ver

# Load Data
file_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data\data_reduced.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)
```

# Formating for parameters
```{python, include=FALSE}
# One-hot encode JourneyWithChildren (0/1 format)
data = pd.get_dummies(data, columns=["JourneyWithChildren"], prefix="JWC")

# Check transformed dataset
print(data.head())
```

# Convert categorical variables
```{python include=FALSE}
# Convert categorical variables to integer codes
categorical_columns = ["primode_cat", "PrimTargetPurp_Cat", "AgeOldChld", "HhStruct", "JourneyComplx", "RespSex", "RespAgeSimple"]

for col in categorical_columns:
    data[col] = data[col].astype("category").cat.codes  # Convert to integer codes

# Convert boolean columns to integers (if applicable)
bool_columns = ["JWC_0", "JWC_1", "JWC_2"]
data[bool_columns] = data[bool_columns].astype(int)

# Drop rows with missing values (or impute them if needed)
data = data.dropna() 
```

# Import database
```{python include=FALSE}
import biogeme.database as db
import biogeme.biogeme as bio
from biogeme import models
from biogeme.expressions import Beta
from biogeme . expressions import Variable

# Load data into Biogeme database
database = db.Database("JourneyChoice", data)
```

# Formatting variable
```{python include=FALSE}
primode_cat = Variable ("primode_cat")
TravelTimeMinutes = Variable ("TravelTimeMinutes")
PrimTargetPurp_Cat = Variable ("PrimTargetPurp_Cat")
HousehNumPers = Variable ("HousehNumPers")
HousehNumAdults = Variable ("HousehNumAdults")
NumChld = Variable ("NumChld")
PartyNumu10 = Variable ("PartyNumu10")
PartyNum1017 = Variable ("PartyNum1017")
AgeOldChld = Variable ("AgeOldChld")
Chldu6 = Variable ("Chldu6")
HhStruct = Variable ("HhStruct")
JourneyComplx = Variable ("JourneyComplx")
RespSex = Variable ("RespSex")
RespAgeSimple = Variable ("RespAgeSimple")

primode_cat = database.DefineVariable("primode_cat","primode_cat")
TravelTimeMinutes = database.DefineVariable ("TravelTimeMinutes","TravelTimeMinutes")
PrimTargetPurp_Cat = database.DefineVariable ("PrimTargetPurp_Cat","PrimTargetPurp_Cat")
HousehNumPers = database.DefineVariable ("HousehNumPers","HousehNumPers")
HousehNumAdults = database.DefineVariable ("HousehNumAdults","HousehNumAdults")
NumChld = database.DefineVariable ("NumChld","NumChld")
PartyNumu10 = database.DefineVariable ("PartyNumu10","PartyNumu10")
PartyNum1017 = database.DefineVariable ("PartyNum1017","PartyNum1017")
AgeOldChld = database.DefineVariable ("AgeOldChld","AgeOldChld")
Chldu6 = database.DefineVariable ("Chldu6","Chldu6")
HhStruct = database.DefineVariable ("HhStruct","HhStruct")
JourneyComplx = database.DefineVariable ("JourneyComplx","JourneyComplx")
RespSex = database.DefineVariable ("RespSex","RespSex")
RespAgeSimple = database.DefineVariable ("RespAgeSimple","RespAgeSimple")
```

# Formatting variable
```{python echo=FALSE}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Assuming you already have a dataframe called 'data'

# List of variables to plot
variables = ["primode_cat", "TravelTimeMinutes", "PrimTargetPurp_Cat", "HousehNumPers", "HousehNumAdults", "NumChld", "PartyNumu10", "PartyNum1017", "AgeOldChld", "Chldu6", 
"HhStruct", "JourneyComplx", "RespSex", "RespAgeSimple"]
             
# Set plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Loop through each variable and create a histogram or countplot
for var in variables:
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
    
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(data[var]):
        sns.histplot(data[var].dropna(), kde=False, bins=20)
        plt.ylabel("Count")
    else:
        sns.countplot(x=var, data=data)
        plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
    
    plt.title(f'Distribution of {var}')
    plt.xlabel(var)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

# log transforming
```{python echo=FALSE}
from biogeme.expressions import Variable, log
import numpy as np

#Define the symbolic log-transformed variable
database = db.Database("JourneyChoice", data)
TravelTimeMinutes = Variable('TravelTimeMinutes')
database.DefineVariable('TTM_scaled', log(TravelTimeMinutes + 1))

# Log transform TravelTimeMinutes using log1p to handle 0s
log_ttm = np.log1p(data["TravelTimeMinutes"])

# Plot the histogram
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
sns.histplot(log_ttm, bins=30, kde=True)
plt.xlabel("log(TravelTimeMinutes + 1)")
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.title("Histogram of Log-Transformed Travel Time")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# Parameters to be estimated
```{python include=FALSE}
# Define parameters to estimate
ASC_JWC_0 = Beta('ASC_JWC_0', 0, None, None, 0) 
ASC_JWC_1 = Beta("ASC_JWC_1", 0, None, None, 0) 
ASC_JWC_2 = Beta("ASC_JWC_2", 0, None, None, 1) 

B_time = Beta("B_time", 0, None, None, 0)
```

#  If all alternatives are always available
```{python include=FALSE}
data["Avail_JWC_0"] = 1
data["Avail_JWC_1"] = 1
data["Avail_JWC_2"] = 1

database = db.Database("JourneyChoice", data)
Avail_JWC_0 = database.variables["Avail_JWC_0"]
Avail_JWC_1 = database.variables["Avail_JWC_1"]
Avail_JWC_2 = database.variables["Avail_JWC_2"]
```


```{python include=FALSE}
# Define utility functions (JWC_2 is the reference alternative, so its utility is 0)
V_0 = ASC_JWC_0 + B_time * TravelTimeMinutes 
V_1 = ASC_JWC_1 +  B_time * TravelTimeMinutes
V_2 = 0  # Reference alternative

# Associate utilities with alternatives
V = {0: V_0, 1: V_1, 2: V_2}
av = {0: Avail_JWC_0, 1: Avail_JWC_1, 2: Avail_JWC_2}
```

```{python include=FALSE}
data["Choice"] = data[["JWC_0", "JWC_1", "JWC_2"]].idxmax(axis=1).str[-1].astype(int)
database = db.Database("JourneyChoice", data)
Choice = database.variables['Choice']
```

```{python, echo=TRUE}
# Define the logit model
logprob = models.loglogit(V, av, Choice)

# Create the Biogeme object
biogeme = bio.BIOGEME(database, logprob)
biogeme.modelName = "JourneyChoiceModel"
biogeme.calculateNullLoglikelihood (av)

# Estimate the model
results = biogeme.estimate()
```


```{python, echo=TRUE}
# Print results
pandasResrults = results.getEstimatedParameters()
pandasResrults
```
```{python, echo=TRUE}
print(results)
```
